items.summary: NHC Advisory 26 (2:00 PM MST / 2:00 PM PDT, Oct 13): Simon still a compact Category 1, 90 mph/977 mb, centered ~115 mi W of Cabo Corrientes and ~115 mi SW of Las Islas Marias, crawling W at 2 mph. KEY CHANGE: Mexico's government discontinued the Hurricane Watch and Tropical Storm Watch for mainland Mexico. Forecast: very slow drift for a couple more days, then a turn north/north-northwest late week; NHC tells interests in west-central Mexico and Baja California Sur to keep monitoring. Coastal rain/swell threats continue.
items.title: Simon Advisory 26 (2 PM Oct 13): mainland Mexico hurricane/TS watches lifted; storm still Cat 1 drifting offshore

items.summary: Gael Gustavo Teran Burgos, 14, was found in the arroyo Oaxaca near Maneadero in the first hours of Tuesday Oct 13 — near where his 4-year-old brother Aaron Vega Burgos was found Monday. He is the fifth and last member of the Sonora family swept away Saturday night when the arroyo El Pipila overflowed (Regina Ivonne 13, Erika Ivonne 35, Silvia Lucero 30, Aaron 4). Ensenada's Rachel toll now stands at 5 dead vs 4 dead/6 missing reported Monday by AP. Five more people remain missing in the El Pipila-Oaxaca area per the FGE; Baja's security chief puts 10 missing statewide (8 Ensenada, 2 San Felipe — an adult and a minor out in a boat). A 3,500-person search operation (Army, Navy, Guard, civil protection, K9, heavy machinery) continues along both arroyos. Note: lado.mx cites a sixth unidentified body — not corroborated by other outlets yet.
items.title: Ensenada: fifth body (Gael, 14) recovered from arroyo Oaxaca; Maneadero family now fully accounted for, 5 still missing
